_comment: Everything Charlie the caddy can say, loaded by scripts/Caddy.gd. Each key is a situation and holds a list of lines; one is picked at random. Placeholders filled in from the game: {name} caddy's name, {mph} wind speed, {yards} hole length, {par} hole par, {pct} distance the rough takes off, {dist} putt length ('12 yds' / '9 ft'), {carry} yards carried, {score} round score ('3 over'), {holes} holes played. Keys listed in _forced are always spoken; every other line is only spoken sometimes, and never straight after another one. Add lines freely; a key with no lines just keeps him quiet.
intro: Name's {name}. Arctic char, professional caddy. I carry the bag, you carry the blame.
Alright? I'm {name}. Yes, I'm a fish. No, I won't be taking questions. Let's play.
{name}, at your service. Coldest fins on the course. I'll keep you right.
I'm {name}, your caddy for the day. I've read every green and most of the lakes.
tee_calm: Not a breath of wind. No excuses on this one.
Dead calm. The water's like glass. My favourite kind of day.
No wind at all. Hit the number on the club and trust it.
Still as a frozen loch. Just swing.
tee_into: {mph} mph straight in our faces. Take more club than you think.
Wind's against us, {mph} mph. Swimming upstream, this. Club up.
Into the wind. High shots will balloon. Keep it low, a Stinger loves this.
{mph} mph headwind. It'll knock yards off. Don't be koi about taking the bigger club.
tee_helping: {mph} mph at our backs. It'll fly, so club down a touch.
Tailwind! We're going with the current. Less club.
Wind's helping, {mph} mph. Get it up in the air and let it ride.
Downwind. Higher shots will catch the breeze, so they'll go further than the card says.
tee_from_left: Breeze from the left. Aim a bit left and let it drift back.
Wind's coming in from the left. It'll push you right, so start it left.
Left-to-right wind. A Controlled Draw would hold its line nicely in this.
Crosswind from the left. Allow for it, or we'll be fishing it out of the right rough.
tee_from_right: Breeze from the right. Start it right and let the wind bring it home.
Wind from the right. It'll push you left, so aim right of where you want it.
Right-to-left wind. A Controlled Fade will hold against it.
Crosswind from the right. Allow for it, or we'll be in the left rough.
tee_gale: It's a gale out here, {mph} mph. Keep it low and don't get greedy.
{mph} mph. That's not wind, that's weather. Low shots only, if you can.
Blowing a hoolie, {mph} mph. Anything high is going for a swim.
I've seen calmer seas in a storm. {mph} mph. Play the percentages.
tee_water: There's water on this one. I'd know. Keep it dry.
Water out there. Lovely for me, a stroke for you. Give it plenty of room.
Mind the water. If you visit my relatives, it costs you a stroke.
I can smell the water on this hole. Don't make me go and fetch it.
Water in play. Aim away from it. Nobody ever won a hole by being brave near a pond.
tee_par3: Par 3, {yards} yards. One good swing and we're putting.
Short one, {yards} yards. Pick the club that gets there without trying.
{yards} yards to the flag. Hit the green and let the putter do the rest.
tee_par4: Par 4, {yards} yards. Fairway first, then think about the flag.
{yards} yards. Two good shots and we're on. No heroics.
Par 4. Put it on the short grass and the rest gets easy.
tee_par5: Par 5. Three sensible shots beat one heroic one.
{yards} yards. It's a long swim, so pace yourself.
Par 5. Get it out there, lay up somewhere nice, and go for the flag with a short club.
Long hole. Don't go for broke, go for the fairway.
tee_last_hole: Final hole. Stay focused and let's fin-ish this properly.
Last one. Whatever happened out there, this hole doesn't know about it.
tips: Tip: don't use a club well short of its range. Babying it forces a bad Form card on you.
Tip: clubs of the same brand work together. Get two, four or seven of a set for bonuses.
Tip: your bag holds 14 clubs. After each hole you draft one more, so choose with a plan.
Tip: landing in rough, sand or water can slip a bad card into your Form deck. Keep it clean.
Tip: In the Zone throws bad cards out of your Form deck. Worth its weight in roe.
Tip: a Stinger flies low and the wind barely touches it. Bump and Run goes along the ground.
Tip: a Flop Shot goes up high and stops dead. Good for getting over trouble near the green.
Tip: finish a shot on the cup and you roll a d20. A natural 20 and it drops in.
Tip: the rough takes about a fifth off your distance and sand takes half. Club up to make up for it.
Tip: the Form deck chip up top shows every card in your deck. Have a look if it's getting murky.
Tip: hover over a brand chip in your bag to see what the next club of that set unlocks.
Tip: Yips is sneaky. It can follow you onto the green and ruin a putt.
Tip: woods won't get you out of a bunker. Don't even think about it.
Tip: in a group, whoever's furthest from the pin plays next. Even if that's you again.
forced_card: No choice here, a bad card's forced on you. Just swing and get it back on track.
Forced card. It happens to the best of us. Keep the damage small.
You can't pick this one. Aim safe and limit the damage.
Bad card, no options. Like being caught in a net. Wriggle out and move on.
yips: Ooh, the Yips. That could follow you onto the green. Try to stay off the fringe.
Yips! Nerves of jelly-fish. That might taint your next putt.
That's the Yips. Shake it off, and keep your next one well clear of the green's edge.
bad_card_added: That trouble left a bad card in your Form deck. Something fishy's swimming in there now.
Your Form deck just got a bit murkier. Look out for In the Zone to clean it up.
A bad card's been added to your deck. Don't worry, we'll flush it out eventually.
land_water: Lovely in there. For me. For you it's a penalty stroke.
Splash. I'll go and say hello to it. That's a stroke, by the way.
Water. Oh my cod. Plus one, and we drop near where we were.
Into the drink. I'd fetch it, but I'm on the clock. One stroke penalty.
That ball's sleeping with the fishes now. Penalty stroke, drop near the last spot.
Water you doing? That's a stroke. Take a breath and go again.
Holy mackerel. Wet ball. One penalty stroke, then we go again.
Well, at least it's somewhere I'd be comfortable. You lose a stroke though.
land_out: That's out of bounds. Stroke and distance, I'm afraid.
Gone. Out of bounds. Let's pretend that was a practice swing.
Out of bounds. Plus one, replay from where we were. Shake it off.
That one's swum off the map. Penalty stroke, go again from the same spot.
OB. That's a reel shame. Same spot, plus one.
Out of bounds. Even I can't swim that far. Plus one, replay it.
land_bunker: Sand. Grab a wedge, get it out, take your medicine.
Bunker. Woods won't get you out of that. Short and simple.
Beach day. Not my scene. Sand halves your distance and forces a bad card, so just get it out.
In the sand. I'm a fish, I hate this bit. Wedge it out and move on.
Bunker. Don't be shellfish with your ambitions, just get it back on the grass.
Sand trap. It's like being stranded at low tide. Get out first, score later.
land_rough: Rough's grabby. It'll take about {pct}% off the next one, so club up.
In the weeds. Expect to lose {pct}% of your distance. Take more club.
Rough. Like swimming through kelp. Club up to make up the {pct}%.
Bit of rough. It'll cost you {pct}% distance. Nothing a bigger club can't fix.
Long grass. Lose {pct}% on the next shot, so plan for it.
land_rough_free: Rough, but your bag shrugs it off. Swing away.
Rough? Your clubs don't care. Full distance, go for it.
In the rough, but your bag has us covered. Play it like the fairway.
land_fairway: Fairway. I can work with that.
Middle of the short stuff. Lovely.
That's fin-tastic. Right where we want it.
Nice and tidy. Like a fish in a clean stream.
Fairway. That's what I'm tackle-ing about.
Sweet as. Short grass, clear look at the flag.
land_fairway_bomb: {carry} yards! That's a whale of a drive.
You absolutely launched that. {carry} yards of carry. I'm hooked.
{carry} yards! Did you have a krill shake for breakfast?
Massive. {carry} yards. The salmon would be jealous of that leap.
land_green: On the green. Now don't three-putt it.
On in regulation, or close enough. Let's roll it in.
Green! Now it's all about the putter. Smooth and steady.
On the putting surface. That's sea-mless.
card_hook: That Hook dragged it left. Don't worry, it happens. I know a thing or two about hooks.
A Hook, eh? You'd think I'd be used to them by now.
Hooked it. At least it wasn't me on the end of it this time.
card_slice: Slice. Sliced like sashimi. We go again.
That Slice peeled away right. Aim a bit left to make up for it.
Sliced. Not my favourite word, as a fish.
card_top: Topped it. Skimmed it like a stone. Not much distance on that one.
Top. It ran along the ground like a nervous minnow.
Topped. Head down next time, and keep your eye on the ball.
card_chunk: Chunked it. More turf than ball, that. Short of the target.
Chunk. You hit the big fat ground. Happens.
Fat one. Dug a trench. Shorter than we wanted.
card_shank: Shank. We don't talk about the shank. And it made your lie worse.
The dreaded Shank. That's a fluke, and not the good kind.
Shanked it. Something fishy about that swing. And the lie's worse now.
card_pure_strike: Pure Strike! Struck it like a pro. Couldn't have done it better myself. Mainly because I'm a fish.
Absolutely pure. Right off the middle. Fin-tastic.
That's a Pure Strike. Bang on the number.
card_stinger: Stinger! Low and hard, like a salmon going upstream.
Lovely Stinger. Kept it under the wind and let it run.
Stinger. That's the shot for a windy day.
card_flop: Flop Shot! Up like a flying fish, down like a feather.
Lovely Flop. High, soft and stopped dead.
Flop Shot. Over the trouble, no fuss.
card_bump: Bump and Run. Along the ground like a bottom-feeder. Very effective.
Nice Bump and Run. Keep it low, let it roll.
Bump and Run. Sometimes the ground's your best friend.
card_draw: Controlled Draw. Right to left, lovely shape.
That Draw curved in beautifully. You had it on a line.
Nice Draw. That's a shot with a bit of char-acter.
card_fade: Controlled Fade. Left to right, soft landing.
Lovely Fade. Held against the wind like a pro.
Fade. Gentle curve, just like it should.
card_big_strike: Big Strike! Full carry, no messing about.
You gave that everything. The whole lake felt it.
Big Strike. That's the club's full distance, right there.
card_in_the_zone: In the Zone! And it cleared out some junk from your Form deck.
You're in the zone. Calm as a still loch.
In the Zone. Keep this up and your Form deck'll be spotless.
rim_out: So close I could smell the cup.
Lipped it! Tap that in before it changes its mind.
Oh, it rattled the cup! Cruel. Short one left.
Rim out! It looked in and said no. Rude.
hole_out: IN! I've seen a lot from the bottom of a loch, but never that.
Holed it! I'm telling every fish in the lake.
You holed it from out there! Well, I'll be battered.
hole_in_one: HOLE IN ONE! I'm doing backflips. Well, I'm flopping about. Same thing.
An ACE! That's the best shot I've ever seen, and I've lived in some very clear water.
Hole in one! I'm going to need a minute. And a bucket of water.
putt_long: Long one. Just get it close. Two putts is fine from here.
Lag it up. Nobody holes these, so leave yourself a tap-in.
{dist}. Hard to hit the marker on this one, so just aim to get close.
Big putt. Don't be a hero, be a two-putter.
putt_mid: Read it, trust it, stroke it.
Nice and smooth. Stop the marker in the green and it drops.
{dist}. Makeable. Watch the marker and time it.
Steady hands. The fish in me believes in you.
putt_short: Short one. Firm and straight, no wobbling.
You've holed a thousand of these. Make it a thousand and one.
{dist}. Wide green band, nice and slow. You've got this.
Easy does it. Don't let the minnow-sized putts get in your head.
putt_close: Good pace. Just slid by. Tap-in territory, nearly.
So near. Good effort, short one left.
putt_miss: Mishit. Still, it's walked closer. Go again.
Off line. Shake it off. The next one's shorter.
That one floundered. Reset and roll it.
holed_eagle: Eagle! I'm flapping about over here.
Eagle! The birds are jealous and so am I.
Two under on the hole. You're a natural. Or a dolphin.
holed_birdie: Birdie. I don't usually like birds, they eat my cousins, but I'll allow it.
Birdie! Let minnow if you want another.
holed_par: Par. Nobody ever lost a round making pars.
Solid par. On to the next.
Par. Steady as a heron. Not that I like herons.
holed_bogey: Bogey. It's the name of the game.
Bogey. Water under the bridge. Hopefully not literally.
A bogey. Don't flounder about it, next tee.
holed_double: Let's forget that one, like a goldfish would. I'm not a goldfish, but still.
Rough hole. The next tee doesn't know about it.
That was a hole and a half. Plenty more fish in the sea.
Not our finest hour. Let's not dwell on it, let's just keep swimming.
round_under: That's the round: {score} over {holes} holes. You're a natural. Same time tomorrow?
{score}! I've caddied for some fine golfers and you're right up there.
Round done, {score}. Hook, line and sinker. Well played.
round_level: Level par over {holes} holes. Solid as a glacier.
Round done, level par. Nothing fishy about that card.
Level par. Not bad at all. Next time we'll go under.
round_over: That's the round: {score} over {holes} holes. Same time tomorrow? I'll bring the bag.
Round done, {score}. There's plenty more fish in the sea, and plenty more rounds.
{score}. We'll get them next time. I'm going for a swim.
